messages:
emily: quick FYI — support reported confusion: Dedicated docs show autoscale examples only as YAML but Console/API export uses JSON. customers copy/paste and get errors.

rick: thanks. which page?

emily: provisioning quickstart, the `autoscale_policy` example uses anchors and comments. console export returns strict JSON.

jamal: i'll convert examples to show JSON + YAML side-by-side and add a curl example. also will add a migration note for SDK param rename `reserved_tier` -> `capacity_profile`.

tara: i'll draft a terraform one-liner for reserved pools and an import note.

link-bot: Link-check: broken anchor found at /docs/dedicated/provisioning.md#autoscale-policy-examples.

emily: also add an inline diff for SDK migration: `- DedicatedClient(reserved_tier="m5-reserved")` -> `+ DedicatedClient(capacity_profile="reserved-m5")`.

jamal: PR opened #2219: adds JSON/YAML examples, curl, and migration diff. tagging @tara for TF snippet.

tara: TF draft: `resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "reserved" { name = "prod" capacity_profile = "reserved-m5" region = "us-west-2" autoscale_policy = jsonencode({min_replicas=2,max_replicas=50}) }` plus `terraform import` note. added billing remark.

emily: please include a short SLA table update: add column "isolation" (isolated vs soft-fallback) and a one-line mitigation: pin model, set autoscale_policy.max_burst, use canary rollouts.

jamal: added SLA row and ASCII fallback diagram. fixed anchor. CI preview at https://deploy-preview/redwood/docs/dedicated/2219.

link-bot: Link-check: all links OK in branch feat/docs/dedicated-2219.

rick: merged. created redirect from old anchor to new section.

emily: LGTM, closing after support KB update.
